name: Salvador Choc — a daughter, Antonia, baptised in 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, Guatemala
researcher_question: What children did Salvador Choc of San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz, Guatemala, and his wife Petrona Ba (also recorded as Petrona Choc), who married there on 9 August 1871, have in the 1870s?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 13, hint-samples.csv row 424, flags adds_daughter, confidence 3). The CSV's tree PID 9CB3-PVT now resolves to MGDD-CB5. Resolved as a TRUE MATCH: the baptism register page image (ark:/61903/3:1:3QHJ-M745-8H2G, image 149 of 407) confirms Antonia, born 15 August 1877 ('quince de Agosto'), baptised 29 October 1877, daughter of Salvador [Choc] and Petrona [Choc], godparents Manuel Tiul and Mª Santos. The index's '1581' birth year is an indexing error for 1877. The mother on the image is 'Petrona [Choc]', identifying her as Salvador's 1871 bride (Petrona Ba / Petrona Choc, GG1G-697), not Petrona Xol (MGDD-Z43), whose 1875 baptism entry for Dominga names her mother under her own surname 'Petrona Mª Xol'. Image reading licensed by calibration against two other indexed entries on the same page: Mª Santos Cual, daughter of Domingo Cual and Albina Cual; and Catalina Quim, daughter of Santiago Quim and Mª Santos Caes — both matched. See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
